leadText: (Japanese: 新アルカデス誕生 The Birth of the New Arcades) is the 73rd chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.
plainText:
(Japanese: 新アルカデス誕生 The Birth of the New Arcades) is the 73rd chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
As Ryouga prepares to take the power of Arcades, Fraud distracts him long enough to get to the statue.
Fraud touches the statue of Garyū, taking the power of Arcades in the process.
Garyū's statue crumbles into dust.
Fraud reveals the power of Arcades: the ability to use Bursts of Pokémon of all seventeen types without a Burst Heart.
Fraud and Ryouga battle again.
